resources.string: Your own recipes, in one calm place, on every device you cook with.

Sign-in did not work. Please try again.
Please confirm that you are 16 or older.
This account is being deleted. You can sign in again once that is finished.
Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
Offline. Showing the recipes saved on this device.
Add the first dish you love to cook. It will be here on every device you sign in on.
This picture is not on this device yet. It will appear after the next sync.
This recipe is no longer here. It may have been deleted on another device.
“%1$s” will be removed from all your devices. This cannot be undone.
The recipe could not be deleted. Check your connection and try again.
That picture could not be used. Try another one.
Enter a whole number from %1$d to %2$d
Use a code such as “en” or “de-AT”
You are offline. Your changes are still here; save again once you are connected.
This recipe was changed somewhere else while you were editing. Reload it to see the latest version; your edits here will be replaced.
You are offline, so the latest version cannot be loaded. Connect and try Reload again.
This recipe was deleted on another device. Save to keep your version as a new recipe.
This recipe is too large to save. Shorten some text and try again.
You have reached the limit of 2,000 recipes.
A picture is too large to upload.
Your picture storage is full. Remove some pictures and try again.
A recipe can have at most 5 pictures.
Your recipe storage is full (20 MB). Delete some recipes and try again.
The recipe could not be saved. Please try again.
The changes you made to this recipe have not been saved.
Tell support this ID if you need help. It does not reveal who you are.
Your recipes stay in your account. This device forgets them until you sign in again.
Recipes asks for your consent before your first import with AI.
Recipes will ask again before your next import. Your saved recipes stay as they are.
Consent could not be withdrawn. Check your connection and try again.
Paste a link to a recipe page, or photograph a recipe from a book or card.
One AI import is free: a link, or AI help with a photo. After that, AI imports come with Recipes Pro.
Reading your recipe… this can take up to a minute. You can keep using the app.
You are offline. The import continues when you are back.
No recipe found in this link or photo.
The result was incomplete. Try another source.
The import did not finish. Please try again.
Your free import was not used.
Connect to the internet to import.
Too many imports today. Try again tomorrow.
This could not be imported. Try another link or photo.
You have used your free import.
More AI imports come with Recipes Pro. Typing recipes in stays free and unlimited.
Check the recipe before you save it. Nothing is in your recipes until you save.
The imported recipe has not been saved and will be gone.
Report a problem with this result
The recipe is wrong or incomplete
Thank you. We will look at this result.
The report could not be sent. Please try again.
Photos are read on your phone, free and unlimited.
Reading the photo on your phone…
This photo was read on your phone. Nothing was sent.
AI makes a new draft from the text your phone read. The text read from the photo is sent, not your changes. This draft is not kept.
Your phone could not read this picture.
AI can try to read it, for example handwriting. The photo is then sent to our server.
To turn a link or photo into a recipe, Recipes sends it to our server on Cloudflare.

A link: our server loads the page. A photo: your phone reads it, and the text is sent only when you ask for AI help with it. The photo itself is sent only when your phone cannot read it and you ask AI to read it, for example handwriting.
Cloudflare's AI models turn it into a recipe draft. We delete what you sent as soon as the import ends and keep the draft for 7 days. Cloudflare does not use it to train AI models.
Nothing is saved to your recipes until you save the draft. You can withdraw this consent in Settings.
30 AI imports a month, from links and photos

The subscription renews automatically at the same price until you cancel it. You can cancel any time in the subscription settings of Google Play or the App Store. Recipes Pro then stays active until the end of the period you have paid for.
The store is not available right now. Please try again later.
The purchase was cancelled. Nothing was charged.
Your payment is not confirmed yet. Recipes Pro starts as soon as it is.
The purchase did not go through. Please try again.
No subscription was found to restore.
Anyone signed in to Recipes who has the link can see the recipe and add a copy to their own recipes. A link works for 30 days and for up to 10 people.
Nobody can open the link any more. People who already added the recipe keep their copy.
The link could not be revoked. Please try again.

The pictures cannot be checked right now. Please try again later.

The link could not be made.
